Engineering

Válvula de alivio de explosión de cárter

A safety device fitted on engine crankcases that vents pressure and flame in the event of a crankcase explosion, reducing risk of damage and crew injury.

Quick answer: A safety device fitted on engine crankcases that vents pressure and flame in the event of a crankcase explosion, reducing risk of damage and crew injury.

Definition

A safety device fitted on engine crankcases that vents pressure and flame in the event of a crankcase explosion, reducing risk of damage and crew injury.

Operational example
